product.name: CRUISE SHIP DAYS - Hop on Hop off - Wine, Beer, Food & Wonders Tour - Marlborough
product.shortDescription:
Making port for a day in Picton? Unsure how to see the best of the region? Hop on one of our tours!

Hop on and discover the Wonders of Marlborough: Wineries, Museums, Activities, Breweries, Shopping, Restaurants and more!
product.description:
PLEASE BE AWARE WE HAVE NOW ADDED A $5 FUEL FEE, DUE TO THE ON GOING INCREASE TO GAS.PRICES.. 

* Please be aware we have a surcharge of 15% if we run on a public hoilday. *

A self guided tour providing complete freedom of movement! Our biggest advantage is that we never rush you. Take your time and enjoy your stops, just follow our simple bus timetable.


Tastings and lunch are at your own expense and will need to be pre booked due to the volume of clients on these days. Please allow 2 stops per tasting, we have 30 minute stops in case you are needing to leave a place but 30 minutes is not long enough to do a tasting. For lunch please allow 3 stops.

Pick up: Picton i-SITE Tourist information centre (your cruise shuttle will drop you here). 

Pick up Times:  9.30am, 10.00am, 10.30am, 11.00am, 11.30am

Click here for our map and timetable: https://hoponhopoffwinetours.com/maps/marlborough-cruise-ship/

Click here for Terms and Conditions. 


TERMS & CONDITIONS
Prior to the day: 
-This is a self guided tour - all tastings are guests' responsibility and at guests' expense. Some wineries will waiver tasting fee when purchasing wine. We recommend booking lunch prior to the day and bringing water with you to stay hydrated. 


On the Day: 


- Please be at your pick up stop 15 minutes prior to departure time. Hop on Hop off does not take any responsibility for lateness. 
- We recommend no more than 8 guests hop off at any given winery - this is to ensure a more intimate and enjoyable experience. 
- Our buses are not licensed which means alcohol cannot be consumed whilst on the bus.

Take the hassle out of your day: We can pre book your stops for you and avoid any disappointment on the day for our most popular stops. $30 per passenger. If you indicate 3-4 stops that you would like to have tastings /or lunch we will book these for you.
NB: Entry, tastings and lunch fees not included in this offer. Due to the time to make bookings this must done 48 hours in advance of your trip.

productSeoTags.attrValue: CRUISE SHIP DAYS - Hop on Hop off - Wine, Beer, Food & Wonders Tour - Marlborough

Make the most of your time ashore with our Cruise Ship Friendly Hop On Hop Off Tour, crafted especially for visitors arriving in beautiful Marlborough. Sit back and relax as we take you on a flexible journey through New Zealand’s premier wine region – famous for its world-class Sauvignon Blanc, craft beer, and delicious local cuisine.

With our easy-to-use hop on hop off service, you can explore at your own pace — choose from a variety of stops including top wineries, breweries, artisan food spots, and scenic highlights. Whether you’re here for just a few hours or most of the day, this is the perfect way to experience the best of Marlborough without the stress.

No rush, no hassle — just taste, explore, and enjoy.
